notes.title: Release of the new game "NeverSynth" 09/15/2022.
notes.notes:
NeverSynth is a 3rd person game that is a rhythm-driving simulator.
This game is a dynamic action game in which you have to drive a car to rhythmic music and collect beats. The more beats you collect, the more game points you earn.

notes.title: Release "Time Lock VR-2" 07/13/2022
notes.notes:
Release "Time Lock VR-2" 07/13/2022

A mystical version of the TimeLock VR game series. The player has to release the soul of an ancestor, enclosed by a sorcerer in a magic stone. To solve the puzzles you will need to travel in time. Be careful, while moving, something can go wrong.

notes.title: Hell Division Release -40%
notes.notes:
Hell Division - a game from the 3rd person, which is a battle of combat drones.
This game is a dynamic action game where the main character is a military drone equipped with small arms. You have to plunge into the atmosphere of cyberpunk and confrontation between two powerful corporations.
